    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: <repository>/configs/open5gs/smf.yaml
        target: /opt/open5gs/etc/open5gs/smf.yaml
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
      - type: bind
        source: <repository>/logs
        target: /var/log/open5gs
        bind: {}
  udm:
    command:
      - open5gs-udmd
      - -c

    volumes:

        read_only: true

      - type: bind
